name: Walton
blurb: Five minutes from Walton village. If your dog comes back from Anglers covered in lake water, we'll have them dry and tidy by tea-time.
metaDescription: Dog grooming near Walton, Wakefield — a 5-minute drive to Keith's K9 Care home salon in Hall Green WF4. IPET-qualified, one dog at a time. Book your dog in.
lead: Five minutes from Walton village, Keith's K9 Care is a calm, one-to-one home dog grooming salon — and the answer to a dog that's just been swimming at Anglers.
body: Walton sits right next to two of the best dog walks in the district — Anglers Country Park and the lakes around Walton Hall. Wonderful for dogs; less wonderful for the back seat of the car. When your spaniel or retriever comes home from Anglers caked in lake water and pond weed, we're a five-minute drive away in Hall Green and we'll have them bathed, dried and tidy by tea-time.

Keith's K9 Care is a home salon, not a busy commercial unit. One dog at a time, in a quiet, purpose-built room — no kennels, no other dogs barking, no rush. It's a calm setup that suits the water-loving breeds Walton seems full of, as well as nervous dogs, puppies and older dogs who don't enjoy a chaotic high-street salon.

Keith is IPET-qualified and grooms every coat type and length — full grooms, puppy first grooms, a quick bath and tidy, nail trims, de-matting and traditional hand stripping for wire coats. Prices are published in full with breed examples, so there's no ringing round for a quote, and Keith confirms the price in person before he starts.

Whether your Walton dog needs a regular six-week groom or an emergency de-tangle after one swim too many, booking in is a quick call, WhatsApp or message. Keith likes a quick chat about coat and temperament first so he can set aside the right amount of time.

faqs.q: How far is the salon from Walton?
faqs.a: About 1.8 miles — a five-minute drive to Castle Meadows in Hall Green (WF4). An easy run round from Walton village.

faqs.q: My dog always swims at Anglers — can you sort the mess out?
faqs.a: That's a regular for us. Book a full groom or a bath and tidy and we'll deal with the lake water, mud and pond smell and send them home dry and fluffy.

faqs.q: Do you groom large dogs and doodles from Walton?
faqs.a: Yes — all sizes and coat types, including retrievers, labradoodles and other heavy coats. Large and doodle full grooms start from £60, confirmed before we start.

faqs.q: What are your hours for Walton dogs?
faqs.a: Keith grooms Tuesday to Friday, 9am to 5pm, and Saturday until 2pm, closed Sundays and Mondays. The hours flex around your appointment, so message 07926 471552 if you need an earlier or later slot. Walton is five minutes away, so fitting a groom into the day is straightforward.

faqs.q: Do you hand strip wire-coated breeds from Walton?
faqs.a: Yes, Keith trained specifically in hand stripping, which keeps a wire coat's colour and texture as it should be. It is the right approach for breeds like Border terriers and wire-haired dogs rather than clipping them off. Tell him the breed when you book so he can set aside the time it takes.

faqs.q: Can I drop my dog off and collect later?
faqs.a: Yes, a drop-off and pick-up works well and is how many Walton owners fit a groom around work. Keith agrees the timing with you when you book, and grooms one dog at a time so yours is never left waiting in a kennel. A quick call sets it up.
